dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent pale longitudinal edges visible along the outer webs of folded primary and secondary flight feathers against darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A gradual transition in pattern scale from fine transverse barring on the nape to broader scalloping on the mantle, with no distinct linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Fine, high-contrast dark transverse barring covering the dorsal aspect of the head and neck.
